invoice_number.description: The supplier's invoice number, labelled 'Invoice No', 'Invoice #' or 'Bill No'

invoice_date.description: Date the invoice was issued, labelled 'Invoice Date', 'Date' or 'Dated'

vendor_name.description: Legal name of the supplier who issued the invoice, labelled 'Supplier', 'Vendor' or 'Sold By'

vendor_gstin.description: Supplier's 15-character GST number, labelled 'GSTIN', 'Vendor GSTIN' or 'GSTIN/UIN'

buyer_name.description: Name of the company being billed, labelled 'Bill To', 'Customer' or 'Billed To'

po_number.description: Purchase order the invoice refers to, labelled 'PO No', 'Purchase Order' or 'PO Number'

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the invoice amounts, labelled 'Currency'

subtotal.description: Amount before tax, labelled 'Sub Total', 'Subtotal' or 'Taxable Value'

cgst.description: Central GST amount in currency (not the rate), labelled 'CGST'

sgst.description: State GST amount in currency (not the rate), labelled 'SGST'

total_amount.description: Final amount payable including all taxes, labelled 'Grand Total', 'Total Due' or 'Amount Payable'

hsn_code.description: HSN or SAC classification code, column 'HSN' or 'HSN/SAC'

quantity.description: Quantity invoiced for the row, column 'Qty' or 'Quantity'

unit_price.description: Price per unit for the row, column 'Rate', 'Unit Price' or 'Price'

amount.description: Row amount before tax, column 'Amount', 'Line Total' or 'Value'
